scenarios.A: Cloud Run function (gcloud run deploy --function, Scheduler OIDC, Secret Manager → BigQuery MERGE)
scenarios.B: n8n on Cloud Run (B1 delivery tail · B2 owns the workflow JSON)
scenarios.C: Hybrid (BigQuery computes · Node 22 job writes back · Breeze consumes · Claude iterates)

.claude/agents/discovery-agent.md.role: Reusable agent: memory recovery → analyst per scenario → adversarial skeptic → pass-sequence synthesis

.claude/agents/implementation-agent.md.role: Reusable agent: one block = one commit via aider recipe or by hand; ledger; workbook; tree; verify before push

.claude/skills/aider-scaffold.role: Reusable tool: aider recipe runner + diff ledger (one .patch per commit)

.claude/skills/aider-scaffold/assets/rec.role: One self-contained aider recipe per building block (what the implementation agent ran, or will re-run with a key)

.claude/skills/pass-sequence.role: Reusable skill ported from mir-load: sequence page, surfaces record, Excel lane workbook with live parity counts

.claude/skills/tree-f-visualizer.role: Reusable tool: this tree (tree /f text, manifest, interactive HTML)

alternative/cloudcompute.md.role: Earlier plan: n8n on a Compute Engine e2-micro VM (kept as the non-serverless alternative)

cloud_function_new_deals.role: The deploy unit uploaded by gcloud run deploy --source (what .gcloudignore leaves in)

cloud_function_new_deals/.gcloudignore.role: Keeps README, n8n JSON, deploy.sh, schema and .env out of the source upload

cloud_function_new_deals/bigquery_schema.role: report_state (+lock_until), new_deals, new_deals_runs, new_deals_last_7d — the shared truth every lane reads and writes

cloud_function_new_deals/deploy.sh.role: Step runner (check-env … invoker | dry | enable | run | replay | probe | status | logs); canonical gcloud run deploy --function; DRYRUN=1 rehearses offline

cloud_function_new_deals/main.py.role: HTTP function: watermark window → HubSpot search → shape + hot score → per-run staging → MERGE → history → watermark; dry mode reads, writes nothing; lease; run audit; JSON logs
cloud_function_new_deals/main.py.notes: also layers L4 L5 L6 L8 L11 L13 L15 L16

cloud_function_new_deals/n8n_NewDeals_De.role: Original delivery flow (webhook → rows → XLSX → email); seed of workflows/NEW_DEALS_DELIVERY.json

cloud_function_new_deals/README.md.role: Function-level description: idempotency model, payload contract, canonical deploy, gate order

deploy/n8n.role: The n8n deploy unit: service manifest + Cloud SQL + secrets + import + scheduler

deploy/n8n/cloudsql.sh.role: Cloud SQL Postgres 17 db-f1-micro — the durable store n8n needs (SQLite on Cloud Run loses everything)

deploy/n8n/deploy_n8n.sh.role: Render service.yaml and gcloud run services replace (declarative, idempotent)

deploy/n8n/import_workflows.sh.role: Import the workflow JSON through the public REST API; PUT by stable id; credential placeholder remap

deploy/n8n/scheduler.sh.role: Cloud Scheduler → n8n webhook with X-Delivery-Token, same clock as A, created paused; enable after the dry run

deploy/n8n/secrets.sh.role: n8n-encryption-key, n8n-db-password, n8n-webhook-token; SAs n8n-run and n8n-bq (key for the BigQuery credential)
deploy/n8n/secrets.sh.notes: HubSpot token is copied into an n8n credential — the lane's secret divergence

deploy/n8n/service.yaml.role: Knative Service: pinned n8nio/n8n image, Cloud SQL, secrets from Secret Manager, minScale 0 / maxScale 1, concurrency 1, cpu always on, health path /health

docs/diffs.role: Diff ledger: every commit as a .patch + INDEX.md (git diff for every suggestion)

docs/architecture.manifest.json.role: Manifest the page renders (tree, lanes cross-tab, counts)

docs/architecture.yaml.role: This file — the annotations behind the tree

docs/architecture_tree.html.role: Interactive tree /f page (offline; published as an artifact)

docs/ARCHITECTURE_TREE.txt.role: tree /f text of the same manifest

docs/EXECUTION_SURFACES.md.role: The record: motions, vocabulary, timeline, what stays open

docs/EXECUTION_SURFACES.xlsx.role: The Excel lane matrix built from the YAML (COUNTIF parity summary identifies the parallel lane)

docs/execution_surfaces.yaml.role: pass-sequence spec: layers L0–L17 × lanes A/B/C with parity words, steps, remediation, equality checks

docs/PASS1_SEQUENCE.md.role: The recipe: deploy.sh steps in order with look commands, the dry-run gate, the branch points (delivery, write-back)

docs/SCENARIOS.md.role: The three lanes condensed: what each needs, in which order, what it costs, what it cannot do

scoring.role: One hot score, three runtimes, pinned by shared vectors

scoring/hot_score_v1.constants.json.role: Every constant and tier boundary once; main.py is checked against it

scoring/hot_score_v1.mjs.role: JS port (Cloud Run job; source for the n8n Code node); raw score == Python within 1e-9 on 15 vectors

scoring/hot_score_v1.sql.role: BigQuery UDF hubspot.hot_score_v1; proven by tests/hot_score_vectors.sql on the first authenticated run

scoring/README.md.role: Which runtime uses which file and how each is verified

sql.role: The compute lane: adapter views, scoring views, transactional weekly script, registration scripts

sql/apply.sh.role: Render ${PROJECT} ${DATASET} ${SYNC_*} and apply every SQL object in dependency order; DRYRUN=1 renders

sql/audit_tables.sql.role: new_deals_history (per deal per run, partitioned) and writeback_log — written by every lane

sql/deals_synced_v1.sql.role: Adapter views over the HubSpot → BigQuery sync (SAFE_CAST; names from .env) + pipeline_labels table/views
sql/deals_synced_v1.sql.notes: the sync is scheduled, never real-time: lookback + 36 h freshness guard replace A's exact createdate window

sql/hot_deals_v1.sql.role: hot_deals_v1 (UDF over open scored deals, per-region ROW_NUMBER, global RANK), top-5 by region, write-back delta view (never NULL)

sql/new_deals_weekly.sql.role: Scheduled script per entity: ONE transaction window → shape → duplicates → MERGE → history → run log → report_state NEW_DEALS_<entity>_C
sql/new_deals_weekly.sql.notes: same target table and frozen columns as A; distinct report_id so A's watermark is never touched

sql/refresh_pipeline_labels.sh.role: Loads pipeline/stage labels from GET /crm/v3/pipelines/deals into pipeline_labels (WRITE_TRUNCATE)

sql/scheduled_query.sh.role: Register/update one scheduled query per entity (every monday 04:00 UTC; DISABLE_SCHEDULE=1 is the gate)
sql/scheduled_query.sh.notes: scheduled queries run on UTC only; 04:00 UTC is always before the 05:30-Zurich write-back and A's 07:00

sql/sync_transfer.sh.role: BigQuery Data Transfer Service HubSpot connector (Preview, free): Deals + Owners daily 02:00 UTC

tests/hot_score_vectors.json.role: 15 golden vectors (every branch of the score)

tests/hot_score_vectors.sql.role: bq query that proves the UDF on the same vectors (ok = TRUE per row)

tests/test_hot_score.py.role: Builds the vectors from main.hot_score, checks constants, runs the JS port, emits the SQL check

tests/test_main_offline.py.role: Fake HubSpot + recording fake BigQuery: dry reads but writes nothing, per-run staging, frozen columns, lease 409, event mode

tests/test_n8n_code.py.role: Generated n8n Code node == main.shape() on identical deals (every row field)

workflows.role: Generated n8n workflows (never hand-edit the Code node or the MERGE SQL)

workflows/src/build_workflow.py.role: Generates the three JSON files from the constants, shape_score.js, the template and the schema; --check gate

workflows/src/node_code.template.js.role: n8n glue around the pure functions: reads the other nodes, builds rows and the four SQL statements

workflows/src/shape_score.js.role: Pure port of hot_score / name_key / shape (injected into the Code node); equal to Python on the parity test

workflows/credentials.map.json.example.role: Credential id remap template for import_workflows.sh

workflows/NEW_DEALS_DELIVERY.json.role: B1: the original delivery flow hardened (Header Auth, zero-row branch, env recipients, respond last) — the delivery tail A posts to

workflows/NEW_DEALS_ERRORS.json.role: Error Trigger → email with workflow, node, execution URL

workflows/NEW_DEALS_FULL.json.role: B2: webhook → window once → HubSpot search (paginated) → labels → recent names → Code shape+score → IF dry → MERGE (inline JSON literal) → history → watermark → run log → XLSX → email → respond
workflows/NEW_DEALS_FULL.json.notes: same table, same key, same frozen columns as A; the HTTP Request pagination parameters are best-effort and validated on import

writeback.role: The only lane that writes to HubSpot: Node 22 Cloud Run job

writeback/bootstrap_property.sh.role: One-time creation of hot_score_v1 / hot_flag_v1 deal properties (GET before POST)
writeback/bootstrap_property.sh.notes: needs a token with crm.schemas.deals.write — the read-only app cannot do this

writeback/deploy_job.sh.role: SAs, grants, job deploy with pinned secret version, Scheduler → jobs.run at 05:30 Europe/Zurich; execute | live sub-commands

writeback/Dockerfile.role: node:22-slim image for gcloud run jobs deploy --source

writeback/index.mjs.role: Read hot_deals_v1_writeback → batch PATCH ×100 → writeback_log; 429/5xx backoff; 207 parsed; WRITEBACK_APPROVE gate; never NULL

.aider.conf.yml.role: aider: auto-commits, attribution, show-diffs, reads CONVENTIONS.md

.aiderignore.role: files aider must never add (secrets, ledger, workbook)

.env.example.role: One settings contract for every lane (PROJECT, REGION, DATASET, FN, SA_NAME, schedules, SYNC_*, N8N_*); scripts refuse placeholders

CONVENTIONS.md.role: Rules every scaffolded block follows (idempotent by construction, gate before live, shared truth in BigQuery, no secrets in git); read by aider on every run
